turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How often should I really change the oil? My dad says every three thousand miles.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That used to be the rule, but most modern cars go much longer, often around five to ten thousand miles. Your manual will give the exact interval.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Changing the subject, heading to Portugal for two weeks and I'm terrified of the roaming bill.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Understandable. Would you rather buy your carrier's travel pass, or get a local eSIM when you land?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sorry, could I ask you something real quick?

turns.text: Oh, sorry Moshi, give me a sec.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My shoulder still hurts from that class on Tuesday. Did yours?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A bit. I think it was all those overhead presses.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I just take a few days off, do you think?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably. Or do lower body stuff and leave your arms alone for a while.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, that's probably smarter than skipping completely.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: And put some ice on it tonight.

turns.text: Hannah, are you using the car tomorrow?

turns.speaker: user
